successors.name: Kingdom of Wessex
successors.text: 'The West Saxons succeeded in conquering Sussex (hitherto under direct Mercian rule), Kent, and Essex' after Ellendun, September 825

ledger.x: c. 455: Hengist, then his son Æsc, found the kingdom of Kent. Infobox 'Established: c. 455'; the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle puts the battle with Vortigern at Ægelesthrep in 455 and says 'Horsa was killed' and 'Hengist succeeded him as king, followed in turn by his son [Æsc]'. Scholars treat Hengist and Horsa as…

c. 604: Æthelberht of Kent becomes overlord of Essex. The Essex page: Æthelberht 'was in a position to exercise some authority in Essex shortly after 604' as Sæberht's overlord; the Æthelberht page has Bede listing him third among the kings with imperium, and says Bede's account of Rædwald of East Anglia is unclear.…

c. 687: Kent revolts and Mul is burned. 'Within a year, his brother Mul was killed in a Kentish revolt, and Cædwalla returned to devastate the kingdom'; the Cædwalla page dates Mul's burning c. 687 (Anglo-Saxon Chronicle) and has Cædwalla abdicating in 688.
688: Oswine takes the Kentish throne with Mercian backing.
689: East Saxon kings are active in west Kent.

c. 691: Wihtred succeeds in Kent (charter evidence 'April to July 691'; Bede's length of reign would give late 690) and Oswine's Mercian-backed kingship ends. The page does not say that Mercian overlordship stopped; recorded as a bridge.
692: the East Saxon kingship in west Kent ends.
764: Offa of Mercia gains supremacy over Kent.
776: the Kentish rebels seem to win at Otford.
785: Offa re-establishes his authority over Kent.
796: Eadberht Præn restores Kentish independence after Offa's death.
798: Coenwulf of Mercia reconquers Kent and installs Cuthred.
825: the Mercian grip on Kent ends at Ellendun.

wars.name: Kentish-West Saxon battle of 568
wars.outcome: Æthelberht's forces were pushed back into Kent; no land changed hands.

wars.name: Mercian invasion of Kent (676)
wars.outcome: Æthelred of Mercia ravaged Kent; no land changed hands on the page.

wars.name: Cædwalla's conquest of Kent
wars.outcome: Cædwalla installed his brother Mul in 686; the Kentish burned Mul c.

wars.name: Mercian war against Kent (Otford)
wars.outcome: The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle: 'the Mercians and the inhabitants of Kent fought at Otford'; the outcome is not recorded.

wars.name: Kentish revolt and Mercian reconquest
wars.outcome: Eadberht Præn's rebellion succeeded after Offa's death in 796; in 798 Coenwulf reconquered Kent and installed Cuthred.

wars.name: West Saxon conquest of the south-east (Ellendun)
wars.outcome: Ecgberht beat Beornwulf at Ellendun in September 825; Æthelwulf then took Kent, Sussex and Essex for Wessex.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is on any page opened: the frontiers are the sea, the Thames estuary and the Weald, drawn approximately; the division of west and east Kent is undated and unbounded.
